In Riverside, CA, a Guatemalan national was taken into USBP custody after being released from a local jail, where he was held on charges of trespassing, possession of a controlled substance, and unlawful drug paraphernalia. This criminal illegal alien was ordered removed in 2013 but never left. Instead, he remained in the country, racking up arrests.
 
Criminal history includes: 
▪️ Possession of a stolen vehicle
▪️ Drug possession
▪️ DUI
▪️ Domestic violence
▪️ Selling alcohol to a minor
 
After years of breaking our laws, you can rest assured knowing he will be deported.

@usbpchiefsdc

tweets.text:
Bi-National Response Leads to Arrest of Three Cartel Members⛔
 
USBP immediately shared real time information with the Government of Mexico (GoM) when they spotted three gunmen across the border in Baja California, Mexico. Mexican authorities swiftly responded, arresting the three individuals and seizing eight long guns, multiple magazines, and a cache of ammunition.
 
We are taking a proactive approach in border security - sharing real-time intelligence with our international partners and maintaining a strong presence at the border to stop illicit activity before it reaches U.S. soil.

GANG MEMBER CAUGHT POSING AS A JUVENILE 🚨
 
A Mexican national claiming to be a juvenile attempted to illegally enter the U.S. Mexican authorities quickly confirmed he is an adult.
 
During the investigation, the individual admitted to being a current member of the Mexican Mafia and a former member of the Sureños gang. He also revealed that he had recently been released from a Mexican prison after serving time for a firearms violation.
 
The U.S. Border Patrol remains focused on securing our borders and keeping criminals out of our communities.

@USBPChiefSDC

tweets.text:
BUOY, OH BUOY: Securing the Rio Grande

Construction crews have begun deploying waterborne barriers at a second location in the Rio Grande Valley Sector, marking the start of a formidable 60-mile deterrent along the river.
These buoys are designed to discourage illegal crossings and steer people away from the dangers of the Rio Grande’s turbulent waters.

These expansions underscore our steadfast commitment to reinforcing our borders and deploying every available resource to ensure a safer, more secure America.

@USBPChiefRGV
